text:
mara: quick check: panels with 6+ series are pushing other widgets offscreen. proposing a compact legend mode (one-line summary) to save vertical space.
eli: sounds good. summary could read '6 series 3 regions  avg' and be clickable to expand.
sam: when collapsed, show 2 swatches + short names (truncate with ellipsis). hover reveals full name.
jun: unit inconsistency is annoying  we switch ms <-> s on zoom. idea: fix a base unit per-chart and add a small unit toggle in header for inspectors.
mara: base unit per-chart makes sense; also support SI prefixes for big numbers.
ashley: copy nit: tooltip should include aggregation and entity, e.g. 'p95 latency 200ms 3 routers'. be explicit.
eli: smoothing should be more discoverable. move primary on/off to header; keep the slider in the panel config. add tooltip 'smoothed (5m)'.
sam: outlier handling: single spikes break trend readability. option A: clamp at 95th percentile + show an inset sparkline; option B: interactive dashed guide to 99th. I prefer clamp + inset.
jun: clamp default 95 for throughput, 99 for latency, configurable. inset clickable to toggle full-range. ARIA label: 'Values clamped at Xth percentile. Press enter to view full-range.'
mara: legend menu change request: 'Hide others' -> 'Dim others' to avoid destructive language. also add 'Show raw outliers' toggle.
ashley: accessibility: ensure keyboard can expand/collapse legends and focus series; announce visibility changes via aria-live. color swatches get labels like 'blue: payment-api-prod'.
design-bot: please add a follow-up doc with mocks and the accessibility checklist. tag eng-runtime + eng-platform.
eli: i'll mock compact legend + inset and drop an SVG by EOD.
sam: i'll add example API payload keys for eng: visual.clamp_percentile, visual.inset_enabled, visual.base_unit, visual.smoothing_minutes.
jun: i'll draft keyboard mappings and aria text.
mara: thanks team. i'll file RFC and link mocks. :white_check_mark:
